svg.title: HEADWATERS tuck back
svg.desc: HEADWATERS tuck BACK panel, 769 x 1069 px @300 ppi, y down. Derived at build time from art/BACK.py: the card back's reversed-out lines as ONE gold foil (flat Lion Gold #B08D57) on Deep Hole board; extra side width = reed ladders; the Source Rosette blind-embossed (emboss plate, non-printing tooling colour). No type.

g.data-plate: blind emboss tooling (non-printing); level 1 = plateau, level 2 = sculpted
